subject: Summary for clusters vs Summary for individuals

messages.author: dda38f02883857ab
messages.subject: Summary for clusters vs Summary for individuals
parts:
Hello

I managed to run the distance model in R to estimate the animal abundance. After putting the model in the summary() function it produces two summaries of the  model, one for clusters and another for individuals. Although the summary for clusters seem to be realistic for me but I'm curios on summary for individuals. Can someone explain ther difference and which one should be reported?

Regards
Abraham

messages.author: 75e0b0abcbafbc7d
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Summary for clusters vs Summary for individuals
parts:
Abraham

If you have a field size​ in your data, then you have surveyed animals that occur in groups (or clusters). In this situation, the software will produce a density of groups. It will convert density of groups into density of individuals (individual animals).  How it makes the conversion depends upon how you have done your analysis.

In most situations, interest is in the number of individuals in the population. But this depends upon your study objectives.
